name: frappe-lint
description: Live diagnostics from frappe-lint (bench lint-lsp) for Frappe apps.

frappeLint.benchPythonPath.description: Optional override. By default this is auto-detected by walking up from the open workspace/file to find sites/apps.txt (the bench marker) and using <bench>/env/bin/python3. Only set this if your bench has a non-standard layout.

frappeLint.doppioPath.description: Optional override for <bench>/apps/doppio. Same auto-detection as benchPythonPath applies; only set this if it guesses wrong.
